sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:00)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops phone.
Arrived on site helping Data centre with bringing equipment upstairs. (photo/video on file).
Recieved a call from QBE about vagrants refusing to move. Heading there now.

Arrived at QBE. Was told the POI was a performer but he had left not long ago to another location. We informed him that next time to inform council wardens due to it being within their jurisdiction. (Standing by for security presence).
Recieved 2 calls 1 from Queen St McDonald's and 1 from Fix it mobiles on Victoria St. Splitting into 2 teams to respond to them.
Arrived at Fit it Mobiles. An angry customer came in asking for prices and getting aggressive about it. He left before we arrived. Store worker said he will send a photo to us.

Arrived at Queen St McDonald's waiting for photo of POI. Same thing as before the POI had left before our arrival. He scattered rubbish all over the toilet but no permanent damage. Standing by for security presence. (photo/video on file).
Heading out to look for POI to issue trespass on behalf of Queen St McDonald's we have a brief description. Male, Greenish jacket with a grey hoodie with a gym mat.
Scoped around the area POI was nowhere to be found will be continuing patrols and keeping a close eye out for the POI.
Welfare checks completed at the following stores:
Welfare check lorne st patrolling down high street.
Arrived at Freyberg Square standing by due to bad whether comencing sweep also.
Received a response from QBE regarding a male performer in front of premises on route to location.

Walked through Vulcan Lane and as we were about to approached the male individual we received a priority call from Tatty's recycle designer regarding a male vagrant shouting and swearing in front of their store due to Tatty's store. We made a educated decision to abandon the male performer for now and attend the response call due to the severity of the incident. On route to location.

When we arrived at Tatty's designer recycle, the staff had said that the male vagrant has left the area and least seen heading towardd Lorne Street. Heading towards Lorne Street to find POI for public safety reason.

Lorne street all clear. We received a response call from Specsavers regarding a male vagrant shouting and screaming in front of the premises on route to location. Description of the male individual is similar to POI we were looking for.
Arrived at response location male vagrant has already left the area up Wyndham Street. patrolling up Wyndham street to find the POI.
No sign of POI from Chemist Warehouse till the corner of Wyndham and Albert St. Standing by for security presence in case POI shows up.
Heading towards QBE to deal with POI performer. But we will check for CCTV from Specsavers.
Arrived at Specsavers the staff will look for CCTV footage and we will come later to receive image of POI. (photo/video on file).

Arrived at location as we approached male performer and asked him to leave the premises politely he cussed at the Security guard for QBE (Marx) that called about this situation and was very verbally aggresive towards him. The performer decided to leave on his own will and not cause any more trouble. Standing by till he moves along with his belongings and provided added security presence.). (photo/video on file).
We received footage and spoke to "Ravi" manager of Specsavers about Auror and the benefits of Auror and that we will issue a trespass on their behalf. (photo/video on file).
